segments.an10.15:1.1: “Yāvatā, bhikkhave, sattā apadā vā dvipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā rūpino vā arūpino vā saññino vā asaññino vā nevasaññināsaññino vā, tathāgato tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho;
segments.an10.15:1.2: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā. Appamādo tesaṃ [tesaṃ dhammānaṃ (sī. ka.) saṃ. ni.5.139] aggamakkhāyati.
segments.an10.15:2.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṃ [jaṅgamānaṃ (sī. pī.) saṃ. ni.5.139] pāṇānaṃ padajātāni, sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ mahantattena;
segments.an10.15:2.2: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā. Appamādo tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
segments.an10.15:3.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, kūṭāgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo sabbā tā kūṭaṅgamā kūṭaninnā kūṭasamosaraṇā, kūṭo tāsaṃ aggamakkhāyati;
segments.an10.15:3.2: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā. Appamādo tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
segments.an10.15:4.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci mūlagandhā, kāḷānusāriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati;
segments.an10.15:5.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci sāragandhā, lohitacandanaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati;
segments.an10.15:6.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci pupphagandhā, vassikaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati;
segments.an10.15:7.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci khuddarājāno [kuḍḍarājāno (sī. syā. pī.), kuṭṭarājāno, kūṭarājāno (ka.) a. ni.6.53], sabbe te rañño cakkavattissa anuyantā bhavanti, rājā tesaṃ cakkavattī aggamakkhāyati;
segments.an10.15:8.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, yā kāci tārakarūpānaṃ pabhā, sabbā tā candappabhāya kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ, candappabhā tāsaṃ aggamakkhāyati;
segments.an10.15:9.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno [abbhussukkamāno (sī.) saṃ. ni.5.146-148] sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca;
segments.an10.15:10.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, yā kāci mahānadiyo, seyyathidaṃ – gaṅgā, yamunā, aciravatī, sarabhū, mahī, sabbā tā samuddaṅgamā samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā, mahāsamuddo tāsaṃ aggamakkhāyati;
segments.an10.15:10.2: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā. Appamādo tesaṃ aggamakkhāyatī”ti.

lines: Pañcame evameva khoti yathā sabbasattānaṃ sammāsambuddho aggo, evaṃ sabbesaṃ kusaladhammānaṃ kārāpakaappamādo aggoti daṭṭhabbo.
Nanu cesa lokiyova, kusaladhammā pana lokuttarāpi.
Appamādena hi te paṭilabhanti, tasmā so tesaṃ aggo.
Yadidaṃ mahantattenāti mahantabhāvena aggamakkhāyati, na guṇaggenāti attho.

Idaṃ kira suttaṃ sutvā bhātiyamahārājā vīmaṃsitukāmatāya ekasmiṃ gabbhe catujātigandhehi paribhaṇḍaṃ katvā sugandhapupphāni āharāpetvā ekassa samuggassa majjhe sumanapupphamuṭṭhiṃ ṭhapetvā sesāni tassa samantato muṭṭhiṃ katvā ṭhapetvā dvāraṃ pidhāya bahi nikkhanto.
Athassa muhuttaṃ bahi vītināmetvā dvāraṃ vivaritvā pavisantassa sabbapaṭhamaṃ sumanapupphagandho ghānaṃ pahari.
So mahātalasmiṃyeva mahācetiyābhimukho nipajjitvā “vassikaṃ tesaṃ agganti kathentena sukathitaṃ sammāsambuddhenā”ti cetiyaṃ vandi.
15-16. Pañcame kārāpakaappamādo nāma “ime akusalā dhammā pahātabbā, ime kusalā dhammā upasampādetabbā”ti taṃtaṃparivajjetabbavajjanasampādetabbasampādanavasena pavatto appamādo.
Jaṅgala-saddo cettha kharabhāvasāmaññena pathavīpariyāyo, na anupaṭṭhānavidūradesavācī.
